Systems & tooling

Validation Automation and Telemetry Pipelines

Planned notes on building repeatable log parsers, regression detectors, and automated data pipelines for multi-system hardware labs.

To be continued…

Planned scope

This planned series covers engineering tooling for large-scale system validation, including configurable log analysis, Python automation, SQL queries, and Airflow pipelines for telemetry triage and regression tracking.

Draft outline

This is a structured draft. Each section will be completed with measured results, commands, and evidence as the work is carried out.

Requirements

  • Define the log sources, volumes, and retention needs.
  • Agree on the questions the pipeline must answer.
  • Record ownership and failure handling.

Log parsing

  • Define scenario rules in a versioned configuration.
  • Parse heterogeneous logs into a common schema.
  • Emit CSV or database records with provenance.

Telemetry analysis

  • Model the metrics and regression questions in SQL.
  • Build scheduled Airflow workflows for ingestion and checks.
  • Record data quality and missing-data behavior.

Regression detection

  • Define thresholds and baseline windows.
  • Generate alerts with links to the underlying logs.
  • Track false positives and tuning changes.

Reporting and references

  • Produce a reproducible summary for each run.
  • Keep configuration, code, and outputs together.
  • Link the tooling and schema documentation.

Topics to cover

  • Scenario-based log parsing and CSV reporting
  • Python test automation and lab orchestration
  • Telemetry analysis with SQL and Airflow
  • Automated regression detection and bug triage
